entities.summary: Parc Merveilleux is a children story park destination in Bettembourg, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: A charming hybrid of storybook environments, play and animals that is especially strong for younger families. This entry is intended for 2–9 travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
entities.whyWorthwhile: A charming hybrid of storybook environments, play and animals that is especially strong for younger families.
